name: Mussoorie, Dhanaulti and Chakrata
one_line: Uttarakhand, from Dehradun up to Mussoorie, east to Dhanaulti, and west past Kempty Falls to the cantonment town of Chakrata

usual_days.value: 2 to 3 nights for Mussoorie and nearby; 2 to 3 days more for Chakrata

source.title: Mussoorie Travel Guide: Best Time, How to Reach & Things to Do

usual_season.value: March to June and September to November

source.title: Mussoorie Travel Guide: Best Time, How to Reach & Things to Do

fuel.note: Pumps are those drawn on the open map within the search radius of the road. A pump missing from the map is missing here, so each gap is a worst case.

rules.title: Mussoorie: online registration before visiting
rules.detail: Visitors register online before arrival and give their vehicle number. Reports differ on the portal and on where passes are checked. Two-wheelers are not mentioned.
rules.set_by: Government of Uttarakhand, on a National Green Tribunal direction as reported

source.title: Online Registration Mandatory Now For Visiting Mussoorie: Step Mooted To Control Traffic

history.change: Announced, with registration on the Dehradun Smart City portal and police checks at Kincraig and Picture Palace.

source.title: Mussoorie Introduces Mandatory Tourist Registration From August 1

history.change: Registration became compulsory; hotels and homestays made to verify it.

source.title: Online Registration Mandatory Now For Visiting Mussoorie: Step Mooted To Control Traffic

rules.title: Mussoorie eco tax on vehicles from other states
rules.detail: An operator guide reports a tax taken at the barrier near Kuthal Gate from vehicles registered outside Uttarakhand. It does not say whether two-wheelers pay. No official page found.

source.title: Mussoorie Travel Guide: Best Time, How to Reach & Things to Do

rules.title: Mussoorie Mall Road: no vehicles in the evening
rules.detail: An operator guide reports vehicles are kept off Mall Road from about 16:00 to 23:00, with hours changing by season. No official notice found.

source.title: Mussoorie Travel Guide: Best Time, How to Reach & Things to Do

rules.title: Chakrata: restricted for foreign citizens
rules.detail: Chakrata is a military cantonment with restricted access. A blog says foreign citizens need a permit in advance from the District Magistrate, Dehradun. Indian citizens show identity. No order found.
rules.set_by: Not found; the cantonment is under the Ministry of Defence

history.change: Blog says those without a permit are turned back at military check posts.

source.title: Chakrata Travel Guide 2026: The Best Offbeat Hill Station in Uttarakhand

rules.title: Uttarakhand green cess: two-wheelers exempt
rules.detail: Vehicles from other states pay a green cess on entry, read by number-plate cameras at the border. Two-wheelers, electric and gas vehicles are exempt. Official order not found.

source.title: Uttarakhand Begins Green Cess Collection From Out-of-State Vehicles, Faces Initial Technical Glitches

history.change: Cess announced, with two-wheelers among the exempt classes.

source.title: Green cess to be imposed on vehicles entering Uttarakhand; EVs, bikes exempted

history.change: Planned start date missed because the systems were not ready.

source.title: Uttarakhand Begins Green Cess Collection From Out-of-State Vehicles, Faces Initial Technical Glitches

history.change: Collection began at border check points, with some technical faults on the first day.

source.title: Uttarakhand Begins Green Cess Collection From Out-of-State Vehicles, Faces Initial Technical Glitches

season.note: No road on this route closes for a season; Dhanaulti and Chakrata get snow in winter and the Chakrata road can shut in heavy monsoon rain.

source.title: Mussoorie registration portal, Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board

authorities.announces: Runs the cantonment; its website posts no visitor rules

hazards.title: Landslides on the road to Chakrata
hazards.detail: A blog reports a narrow, winding road with landslides in the monsoon, shut at times in heavy rain.

source.title: Chakrata Travel Guide 2026: The Best Offbeat Hill Station in Uttarakhand

hazards.title: Winter snow at Chakrata and Dhanaulti
hazards.detail: Snow can disrupt road access in December and January.

source.title: Chakrata Travel Guide 2026: The Best Offbeat Hill Station in Uttarakhand

gaps: No highway numbers sourced for the Dehradun to Mussoorie, Mussoorie to Dhanaulti or Kalsi to Chakrata roads.

Chakrata: no official page states the rule for foreign citizens. Sources disagree on who grants permission (the District Magistrate in Dehradun or the military command). The cantonment board website says nothing on visitors.
No source found for any gate timings on the Kalsi to Chakrata road.

Mussoorie registration: whether it applies to motorcycles, and whether it runs all year or only in peak periods, was not confirmed. The official Mussoorie page opened is for hotel owners; the guest registration page was not opened.
Mussoorie eco tax and the Mall Road vehicle ban are reported by one operator guide; no municipal notice found. Amounts left out.
No source found for rules or fees at Kempty Falls.
Uttarakhand green cess: the exemption for two-wheelers is reported by two news outlets; no Transport Department order or official page was found.
No rider videos collected; the search budget ran out before this route.
